name: N3XRA Project Pulse

summary.statement: N3XRA is a connected technology platform comprising approximately 163,000 lines of source code across customer experiences, software products, APIs, database systems, administrative tools, and operational infrastructure.

products.name: Websites & Client Services
products.summary: Custom websites, project intake, AI-assisted proposals, onboarding, branded client portals, asset delivery, billing, and ongoing client service.

products.name: N3XRA Records
products.summary: Searchable records, documents, communication, meeting notes, speaker-aware transcripts, phone-connected meeting capture, organization workspaces, and access controls.

products.name: N3XRA Utilities
products.summary: Operational portals, customer access, onboarding, workspaces, and administration for utility organizations.

products.name: N3XRA Virals
products.summary: Video analysis, comparisons, reusable frameworks, scripts, creator tools, and account workflows.

products.name: AI Music Generator
products.summary: Prompt-based song generation, account access, song history, audio processing, and usage controls.

products.name: N3XRA Partners
products.summary: Partner applications, referrals, commissions, attribution, onboarding, reporting, and administration.

products.name: N3XRA Company Platform
products.summary: Shared identity, customer dashboards, billing, support, AI receptionist, transactional messaging, careers, governance planning, and web and mobile administration.

recentCapabilities.title: Clearer meeting upload and processing
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA Records now gives users a focused, progress-aware save experience while uploaded or recorded meeting audio is securely prepared for review.

recentCapabilities.title: Careers and applicant workspace
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA now accepts structured career applications, optional résumés, and account-linked applicant details, then organizes submissions, notes, statuses, and follow-up in a dedicated talent workspace.

recentCapabilities.title: Branded website management portals
recentCapabilities.summary: Website clients can receive a management portal configured from their project context, with recommended branding, theme controls, approved logos and favicons, readiness checks, and controlled activation.

recentCapabilities.title: Connected website asset libraries
recentCapabilities.summary: Website files and approved assets now move through shared, live-updating libraries with previews, organized uploads, optimized CDN delivery, and clearer access for clients and administrators.

recentCapabilities.title: Unified N3XRA administration
recentCapabilities.summary: Company and product administration now share a more consistent account-connected workspace for customers, websites, applications, billing, support, operations, analytics, and platform access.

recentCapabilities.title: Review-first website proposals and agreements
recentCapabilities.summary: Website proposals now move through a clearer onboarding-first drafting, revision, email preview, client approval, agreement, and billing-preparation workflow.

recentCapabilities.title: Targeted customer update messaging
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA administrators can prepare, preview, and send product-aware updates to selected customer audiences through account notifications or email.

recentCapabilities.title: Human-reviewed Proposal AI
recentCapabilities.summary: Proposal AI can draft an entire website agreement or improve individual sections from approved intake, onboarding, project, and asset context, while keeping every suggested change subject to human review.

recentCapabilities.title: Precision-first speaker identification
recentCapabilities.summary: Records speaker identification now favors verified matches over uncertain guesses, reducing false assignments while preserving the human correction workflow.

recentCapabilities.title: Mobile admin notifications with scoped review access
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA added a mobile administration experience for secure notifications and introduced isolated reviewer access for approved app-review workflows.

recentCapabilities.title: Guided website onboarding
recentCapabilities.summary: Website customers now move through a focused, progress-aware onboarding workspace covering business details, brand direction, content, technical needs, legal and launch requirements, files, and final review.

recentCapabilities.title: Private business information workspace
recentCapabilities.summary: Authorized administrators can keep frequently used company identifiers, registration details, filing contacts, and supporting N3XRA Files together in one protected company record.

recentCapabilities.title: Rebuilt website client workspace
recentCapabilities.summary: Website services, progress, proposals, onboarding, assets, billing, renewals, and support now share one selected-project context and a more consistent client portal experience.

recentCapabilities.title: More resilient website request management
recentCapabilities.summary: The website project pipeline can now recover completed intake details, surface requests through the protected admin workflow, and remove recoverable intake records when appropriate.

recentCapabilities.title: N3XRA Files and CDN publishing
recentCapabilities.summary: A new internal file workspace supports multi-file and folder uploads, nested navigation, search, previews, approvals, downloads, and controlled publishing of approved assets to the N3XRA CDN.

recentCapabilities.title: A more focused administration inbox
recentCapabilities.summary: Administrative notifications now prioritize decisions, exceptions, account changes, support requests, and items that need review while reducing routine activity noise.

recentCapabilities.title: Shared Records workspace for administration
recentCapabilities.summary: Authorized platform administrators can open a shared N3XRA Records workspace directly from their account while keeping product oversight tools separate.

recentCapabilities.title: Interruption-aware AI receptionist
recentCapabilities.summary: Phone conversations now use sentence-sized speech, backchannel filtering, natural-pause tolerance, larger complete answers, and exact resume behavior when a caller interrupts and asks to continue.

recentCapabilities.title: Human-reviewed speaker identification
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA Records now separates meetings into generic speakers, matches consenting members through optional voice profiles, and gives editors a branded correction workflow with short per-speaker audio samples for verification.

recentCapabilities.title: Configurable, editable meeting minutes
recentCapabilities.summary: Meeting workflows now support brief, standard, or detailed minutes, editable AI drafts, structured review, and a deliberate handoff into Document Builder before the final record is sent.

recentCapabilities.title: Secure record-packet transfers
recentCapabilities.summary: Authorized administrators can invite another organization to accept a complete meeting packet, including its recording, transcript, notes, references, and generated documents, with prior share links revoked on transfer.

recentCapabilities.title: Account-connected phone and messaging setup
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA accounts now remember each customer's receptionist phone setup and messaging preference, show saved security status, and prompt incomplete accounts to finish setup.

recentCapabilities.title: Consent-aware transactional messaging
recentCapabilities.summary: Customers can opt in through N3XRA's public web form or by texting START, receive requested links and account-related updates, and use STOP or HELP at any time.

recentCapabilities.title: Opportunity-aware live call handoffs
recentCapabilities.summary: The receptionist evaluates business context, announces approved handoffs, and can privately brief N3XRA leadership before connecting qualified customer, project, partnership, or investment calls.

recentCapabilities.title: Secure phone account assistance
recentCapabilities.summary: Recognized callers can use a keypad PIN for an account overview or request a password-reset email sent only to the address already associated with their account.

recentCapabilities.title: N3XRA AI receptionist
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA's dedicated phone number now answers with a branded conversational AI voice that can explain the platform, capture caller needs, and guide people toward the right next step.

recentCapabilities.title: Printable website payment history
recentCapabilities.summary: Website-project customers can open a print-ready payment history that summarizes charges, completed payments, current balances, and the applicable payment schedule.

recentCapabilities.title: Approved partner workspace
recentCapabilities.summary: Approved N3XRA partners now have an account-connected workspace for referral activity, earnings, program details, and next steps, with profile details carried into applications where available.

recentCapabilities.title: Guided Records AI navigation
recentCapabilities.summary: Ask Records AI can now offer safe action buttons that open the right Records page and spotlight the relevant tool without submitting forms or changing customer data.

recentCapabilities.title: Resilient Meeting Notes recording
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA Records can preserve and resume interrupted browser recordings, maintain a clear interruption timeline, and create consistent playback and transcript sources.

recentCapabilities.title: Voice-enabled Records AI
recentCapabilities.summary: Records users can ask product-help questions by voice and listen to spoken answers throughout authenticated Records workspaces.

recentCapabilities.title: Device-aware Records AI guidance
recentCapabilities.summary: Records AI now adapts its navigation instructions to the user's desktop or mobile layout and current location in the app.

recentCapabilities.title: Refined Records workspaces
recentCapabilities.summary: Document Builder, Communication, Library, and Meeting Notes gained more focused layouts and clearer workspace controls across screen sizes.

recentCapabilities.title: Phone meeting usage and retention controls
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA Records added organization-level usage reporting and protected retention infrastructure for phone meeting recordings.

recentCapabilities.title: Phone-connected Records meetings
recentCapabilities.summary: Eligible Records organizations can connect telephone calls to the existing meeting workflow for recordings, transcripts, notes, and finalized minutes.

recentCapabilities.title: Refined Records workspace
recentCapabilities.summary: Records gained clearer desktop navigation, organized library administration, improved account pages, and a more focused communication workflow.

recentCapabilities.title: N3XRA Operations
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA added an internal financial operations workspace for invoices, expenses, ledger activity, banking records, reporting, and audit review.

recentCapabilities.title: Loan Tracker
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA introduced a private loan workspace for payment tracking, payoff comparisons, amortization schedules, controlled access, and exports.

recentCapabilities.title: Ownership update interest flow
recentCapabilities.summary: Visitors can request future company and ownership updates through an account-connected experience.

recentCapabilities.title: Partner terms and protections
recentCapabilities.summary: Public partner terms now explain commission structure, program expectations, and change-of-control protections.

recentCapabilities.title: Referral-connected product signup
recentCapabilities.summary: Records and AI Music signups can preserve an eligible partner referral as a customer creates an account.

recentCapabilities.title: N3XRA Partner Program
recentCapabilities.summary: Visitors can explore N3XRA partner opportunities and apply to participate in approved referral programs.

recentCapabilities.title: Smarter Ask N3XRA guidance
recentCapabilities.summary: Ask N3XRA gained broader site knowledge to help visitors understand products, services, support, and where to go next.

recentCapabilities.title: Connected website project experience
recentCapabilities.summary: Customers can move from a website request through proposal, onboarding, project progress, files, and ongoing service.

recentCapabilities.title: Refreshed N3XRA public experience
recentCapabilities.summary: The public N3XRA site gained a clearer introduction to its work, software, services, and ways to get started.

recentCapabilities.title: Clearer Records usage and billing
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA Records customers gained clearer visibility into plan usage, limits, and billing status.

recentCapabilities.title: Utility meter billing workflow
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA Utilities added structured meter-data and billing workflows for participating utility organizations.

recentCapabilities.title: N3XRA Utilities
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA introduced a connected utility platform for customer access, onboarding, operations, and organization workspaces.

recentCapabilities.title: Virals creator and billing programs
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA Virals added customer billing and creator-affiliate participation workflows.

recentCapabilities.title: N3XRA Virals analyzer
recentCapabilities.summary: Visitors gained a workflow for turning TikTok videos into reusable frameworks, hooks, scripts, captions, and ideas.

recentCapabilities.title: Shared N3XRA account
recentCapabilities.summary: One N3XRA account began connecting customers to their available software, services, and product dashboards.

recentCapabilities.title: Records Help AI
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA Records added an AI-assisted help experience for questions about records workflows and product guidance.

recentCapabilities.title: AI Music workspace
recentCapabilities.summary: N3XRA introduced an account-connected workspace for creating, reviewing, and saving generated songs.
